name: ERPNext
label: ERPNext — Frappe REST /api/resource/{Doctype}
description: Official Frappe REST /api/resource/{Doctype}. Docs: https://docs.frappe.io/framework/user/en/api/rest. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. Accounting doctypes (Sales Invoice, Payment Entry, …) via doctype — one node. Replace example host; engine baseUrl is fixed.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for ERPNext. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: resource_get | resource_list | resource_create | resource_update | resource_delete. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: doctype
schema.description: URL path parameter `doctype` for operations: resource_get, resource_list, resource_create, resource_update, resource_delete. Required by: resource_get, resource_list, resource_create, resource_update, resource_delete.

schema.label: name
schema.description: URL path parameter `name` for operations: resource_get, resource_update, resource_delete. Required by: resource_get, resource_update, resource_delete.

schema.label: doc
schema.description: Frappe document fields merged at the JSON root for resource_create (POST /api/resource/{doctype}) and resource_update (PUT /api/resource/{doctype}/{name}). Keys are the DocType's fieldnames; doctype/name stay on the path. Example: {"description":"Follow up"}. https://docs.frappe.io/framework/user/en/api/rest

schema.label: fields
schema.description: resource_list query fields: JSON array string of fieldnames. Example: ["name","status"].

schema.label: filters
schema.description: resource_list query filters: JSON array string. Example: [["status","=","Open"]].

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: resource_get | resource_list | resource_create | resource_update | resource_delete. Default resource_get. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: ERPNext credential (header Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged. Pack Frappe token as api_key:api_secret (engine sends Authorization: token {api_key}).

configurationParameters.label: base_url
configurationParameters.description: ERPNext / Frappe site origin, no trailing slash. Example: https://erp.example.com.

configurationParameters.label: doctype
configurationParameters.description: Default DocType when INPUT doctype is empty. Example: ToDo.
